summary: Wise Group plc filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) disclosing daily open-market repurchases under its previously announced buyback. Between 28 September and 2 October 2026 the company bought 1,385,601 Class A ordinary shares, 400,000 on Nasdaq/other US venues and 985,601 on the LSE and other UK venues, via Goldman Sachs International, at volume-weighted averages of roughly GBP 8.59-8.64 and USD 11.28-11.46. Shares are held in treasury; the program targets up to GBP 405 million (about USD 540 million). Watch execution pace and any buyback expansion.
